inlines.v: CONFIDEN'TIAL, adjective 1. Enjoying the confidence of another; trusty; that may be safely trusted; as a confidential friend. 2. That is to be treated or kept in confidence; private; as a confidential matter. 3. Admitted to a special confidence.
